fact: The World Bank's WURI-Niger implementation support mission of 9-13 December 2024 reviewed a draft identification law under which the unique ID number (NIU) is attributed to persons on the national civil register and civil acts are communicated to the identification body, and recommended a reconciliation of identification data with civil register files.
title: Programme d'Identification Unique pour l'Intégration Régionale et l'Inclusion en Afrique de l'Ouest (WURI, P169594) - Mission d'appui à la mise en oeuvre, Aide-Mémoire
